items.title: Before
items.hook: Hiroshima was a city of ordinary mornings.

moreInfo.title: A city
moreInfo.audioText: Before 6 August 1945 this was a city of work, school, trams and breakfast. Remember that first. The bomb did not fall on an empty map.

items.reveal: Start from people, not from a weapon.

items.title: Sadako
items.hook: If you visit the children’s monument, read Sadako’s name slowly.

moreInfo.title: Cranes
moreInfo.text: Sadako Sasaki folded paper cranes while ill after the bomb. Confirm the biography before live. Do not turn cranes into a cute badge.
